[Shot 1] The camera looks straight down from the ceiling over the centre of the room; the wall opposite the fireplace lies along the bottom edge of the frame, the fireplace wall along the top. The crimson Turkish hearth rug fills the centre half of the frame. The fireplace's hearth and mantel shelf run along the top edge. The dark-red leather armchair, its seat cushion and both arms seen from above, sits in the left third beside the hearth; the green velvet armchair sits in the right third facing it. The writing desk top, heaped with papers and books, fills the lower left corner, and the bay window's sill and lace edge run along the far left edge. Shafts of gold sunlight fall across the rug from the left; the edges lie in indigo shadow. The furniture stands unoccupied, the room still.
